description: Регистър на язовирите на територията на област Перник is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Областна администрация Перник. Public register of dams located on the territory of Pernik district; Up-to-date on 11.06.2016. Coverage: Областна администрация Перник. The portal shows the English title as "Register of dams in Pernik region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Областна администрация Перник. Its keywords include Брезник, РМС 214/2016, язовири, област Перник, водоеми, Перник. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
